title: Elastic potential energy
description: Essential: The answer must state that the elastic potential energy at A equals the kinetic energy at B, giving E_p = (1/2) m v_1^2.

title: Friction work expression
description: Essential: The answer must provide the correct expression for the work done by friction from B to C: W_f = (5/2)mgR - (1/2)mv_1^2.

title: Landing distance from B
description: Essential: The answer must state that the horizontal distance from the landing point to B is 2R.

title: Condition at point C
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law at point C, equating centripetal force to weight to find v_2 = sqrt(gR).

title: Energy conservation from B to C
description: Important: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem from B to C, accounting for gravity, friction, and kinetic energy change.

title: Projectile motion analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly analyze the free-fall motion from C to the ground to find the time of flight.

title: Horizontal displacement calculation
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly calculate the horizontal displacement from C as x = v_2 * t.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the work done by friction is given a positive sign or if the gravitational work term has an incorrect sign.

title: Incorrect centripetal condition
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the condition at C uses an incorrect force (e.g., normal force not zero) or misstates v_2.
